basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software developer from Stuttgart, Germany, currently working remotely for a tech startup. I have a keen interest in football, especially following my favorite team, VfB Stuttgart. When I'm not coding or catching a match, I'm usually diving into VR tech or tuning into political podcasts, particularly The David Pakman Show. I live with my two cats, Mittens and Socks, who are my constant companions. Typically, I'm online in the late evenings after work and during weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship, and my partner shares my love for tech and football.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, having graduated with a degree in Software Engineering. Over the years, I've honed my skills through both formal education and self-learning, particularly in virtual reality and emerging technologies. My interest in politics is mostly self-taught, driven by a desire to stay informed about global events.
